reuse.why: Hooks the new rule into the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked guard that every link handler already calls, though it writes a raw SELECT instead of the existing db.getAccount.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written once and reaches all six provider link functions through the shared guard.

placement.why: Runs at the right point in the link flow, but the closed-account rule is put inside a guard named for the duplicate-link rule rather than in its own check.

scope.why: Only the guard and focused tests change.

maintainability.why: Small and centralised; the function name no longer describes everything it enforces, which a maintainer may trip on.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all link*Account handlers
